Kevin Trudeau's own team told him it was impossible. Nobody sells a book through a TV infomercial, they said. Not enough margin. Too cheap a product to ever work.

He wrote it anyway: Natural Cures They Don't Want You To Know About, with no guarantee a single copy would sell.

It became the number one best-selling book in America that year, number one on the New York Times list for 26 straight weeks, and sold almost 50 million copies in hardcover.

What 'impossible' idea have you been talking yourself out of?

#kevintrudeau #success #mindset #bestseller #adversity #wealth

Kevin Trudeau was hit with a $37 million judgment from the government. His own lawyers told him a receiver would take everything: the houses, the furniture, even his toothbrush.

Instead of folding, he asked a different question. What if he started something the government could never touch? A brand-new foundation, with nothing in it to seize.

That foundation became the Global Information Network, the club he calls the greatest success club in the world.

What would you build if losing everything stopped being the worst option?

#kevintrudeau #adversity #success #mindset #wealth #resilience
